module calendar (
    input CLK,
    input RST,
    output reg [5:0] Hours,
    output reg [5:0] Mins,
    output reg [5:0] Secs
);
    
    
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Secs <= 6'd0;
        end else begin
            Secs <= (Secs == 6'd59) ? 6'd0 : Secs + 6'd1;
        end
    end

    
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Mins <= 6'd0;
        end else begin
            if (Mins == 6'd59) begin
                Mins <= (Secs == 6'd59) ? 6'd0 : Mins;
            end else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
                Mins <= Mins + 6'd1;
            end
        end
    end

    
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Hours <= 6'd0;
        end else begin
            if (Hours == 6'd23) begin
                Hours <= (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) ? 6'd0 : Hours;
            end else if (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
                Hours <= Hours + 6'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
